text:
alex_pm: quick heads-up — I'm sketching a PRD for 'limits & billing semantics' for Q2 initiative. Need acceptance criteria + edge cases for API + UI + billing; opening thread to collect concrete things we must ship.

priya_eng: +1. main API points: per-org vs per-key limits, headers + 429 semantics, prefer soft-limit warnings. Suggest headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1763507723
```
Also add per-request `x-consume-tokens` when applicable.

sam_billing: billing notes: metering should count 'billable tokens' separate from enforcement tokens. Pricing semantics options:
- soft cap: notify + free credit buffer
- hard cap: block requests (429)
We need clear mapping from tokens -> currency and a monthly rollup export.

jordan_cs: customers want per-team quotas, UI to request limit increase, and email/SMS alerts when usage > 80%. Also edge: shared API keys across microservices — need explainers.

luca_legal: contract considerations: fair-use clause, SLA for quota enforcement windows, and audit logs for disputes. retention = 1 year for billing disputes.

priya_eng: acceptance criteria draft:
- API returns documented headers and error body for 429/402 (if billing block).
- UI shows per-route and per-team quotas and usage with 1h/24h/30d rollups.
- Billing exports contain tokens + price basis + proration for mid-cycle changes.
- E2E tests simulate bursts and verify fallback to cheaper model variant.
Edge cases:
- clock skew between regions -> use server-side reset timestamps
- retries with idempotency keys should not double-count tokens
- cached responses shouldn't count

alex_pm: launch checklist (minimal):
- API + docs
- Console quota UI + request flow
- Billing export + contractual language
- 10 customer pilots + migration notes
- run chaos tests for region fallback
If all agree I'll fold into PRD and open RFC.

deploy-bot: created PR #3201 for `limits-prd` — links: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/3201

sam_billing: one ask — add API to query current soft-limit and available buffer (so SDKs can surface warnings).

priya_eng: noted. I'll add `/v1/limits/status?org_id=` endpoint to the spec.

alex_pm: thanks all — I'll update PRD by EOD and tag stakeholders. :thumbsup:
